stderr.text: Export failed: Document Missing Template Error

established: The installed version-bound reader made one TOC export attempt on this unchanged read-only package and returned a normal process exit of 10 with the exact retained error text.
The refusal occurred without a timeout, output truncation, orchestrator signal, or unresolved cleanup condition; no TOC bytes were produced.
The inspected package has exactly the two retained regular files and three directories listed in the manifest, with unchanged bytes and mode bits after this attempt.
The producer and reader report the same Xcode version/build text: 26.3 / 17C529. This does not itself prove equality of every producer/reader framework byte.

existingDocumentationGap.exportHelp: Retained 26.3 export help documents .trace input, TOC versus XPath modes, and stdout output; it does not define the missing-template error or an embedded template member.
existingDocumentationGap.installedManual: Retained 26.3 manual describes importing a supported input format into a new trace using a template, with imported data depending on the instruments in that template. It does not name ATRC among supported formats or define the missing-template error.
existingDocumentationGap.rawFormat: The existing filename and bounded header metadata do not independently qualify the entire ATRC payload as an accepted input of a particular 26.3 importer.

hypothesis.missingProof: A version-bound document/template contract or reader diagnostic must identify the relevant missing/unresolvable document element; neither the filename inventory nor the error label identifies it.
hypothesis.statement: Incomplete trace-document finalization is consistent with the two-file package, prior abnormal recorder exit, and reader-reported missing-template error.

notEstablished: Which required template object, identifier, member, file path or serialization format is absent or unresolvable; the message alone does not specify one.
That the globally installed System Trace template is absent, or that switching record --template to --instrument would address this case.
That the D24 SIGSEGV caused loss of particular metadata, or that its stopping signal caused the SIGSEGV.
That the prior Time Mapping issue caused this error, or what that issue severity or timestamp means.
That the raw ATRC data has no usable events, or that any rows cover the original sampler window.
That every reader configuration would refuse this package; the effect of the read-only input mode was not independently varied.
A documented meaning for numeric exit code 10 beyond its observed occurrence with this stderr.
A qualified trace epoch, clock conversion, event range, sampler phase, activation route or IPC chain.

limitations: TOC exportability is separate from recording completion, usable clocks and event/table coverage.
Read-only mode bits and unchanged final hashes do not prove the tool attempted no writes or created no caches elsewhere.
Final process-group snapshots establish no live members at the snapshot time, not every descendant's exit time at the command deadline.
The original D24 recorder exited on signal 11; this diagnostic does not reclassify that recording as complete.
